meta.title: Contact — Shopify Bundle App Support
meta.description: Get in touch with the PushBundle team. Email us, start a live chat, or book a meeting — we reply within 24 hours.

hero.title: Let's talk bundling
hero.subtitle: Ran into a bundling challenge or have an idea to improve your store? We'd love to hear from you. Let's chat and explore how we can turn smart ideas into powerful solutions.

sidebar.taglineBody: Call us, book a meeting, or drop your project details below. We'll get back to you within 24 hours. Promise!

methods.title: Send an Email
methods.body: Got something on your mind or facing any issues? Drop us an email. We are all ears and happy to help you.

methods.title: Let's Chat
methods.body: Have questions? Our team is here for you Monday to Friday, almost around the clock.

methods.title: Set a Meeting
methods.body: Prefer a face-to-screen? Book a meeting and let's talk about bundling, your way.

form.successBody: We'll get back to you within 24 hours.
